purpose: Test whether the frozen 37-dimensional FRC sufficiency head can transfer across public datasets without using target-dataset train labels, while retaining target-only calibration of the automatic safety threshold.

development_boundary.reason: Existing confirmation reports refit the head on each target dataset and therefore do not establish model-parameter transfer.
development_boundary.required_next_confirmation: Only an all-checks post-hoc transfer candidate may be frozen for one later confirmation on genuinely untouched data or independently judged flood-domain data.

frozen_split_and_selector.case_assignment: SHA-256(split_version, case_id): 40% train, 30% calibration, 30% evaluation within every dataset.

frozen_transfer_head.source_training_data: For each target and split version, only train variants from the other three datasets are used.
frozen_transfer_head.pool_weighting: Each source dataset receives equal total weight; within each source dataset, complete and incomplete classes each receive half of that dataset's weight.
frozen_transfer_head.standardization_weighting: Weighted means and variances use the same equal-dataset, equal-within-dataset-class weights as model fitting.

frozen_target_calibration.unit: Maximum transferred-head score among incomplete variants in each target calibration case family.
frozen_target_calibration.declaration_rule: Declare complete only when the target evaluation score is strictly greater than the target calibration threshold.

reference_comparator.method: Existing target-fitted linear L2=4 global split-conformal head on the identical split version.
reference_comparator.purpose: Separate model-parameter transfer from the already established per-dataset refit result.

execution_policy.if_all_checks_pass: Freeze the transferred-head method before selecting or inspecting any new confirmation dataset.
execution_policy.if_any_check_fails: Retain the negative result and do not use a new dataset to continue this transfer-method selection cycle.

theoretical_scope.head_transfer_claim: The experiment can test parameter portability across the four revealed public datasets because target train labels are excluded from the transferred head.
theoretical_scope.calibration_claim: The finite-sample marginal statement still requires exchangeability between target calibration and target evaluation case families.
theoretical_scope.reason_not_zero_shot: Target calibration labels are used to set the conformal threshold.

gate_policy: This post-hoc cross-domain experiment cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW or authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
